title: Front-End Developer | Shopify / React / JavaScript / .NET
description:
Join our incredible software team and help create innovative applications that support our internal Sales, eCommerce, Logistics, and Accounting operations. A successful candidate in this role will be a critical thinker, a professionally kind collaborator, and a proven problem solver who works well in teams and under pressure with often competing deadlines. This is an opportunity to apply your existing front-end development, Shopify, React, JavaScript, and .NET skills in an Agile and collaborative team environment. We are excited to welcome you to our growing team!



Job responsibilities include:



* Design and develop responsive, high-performance front-end experiences for our eCommerce storefronts and internal web applications.

* Build and maintain custom Shopify themes, apps, and integrations that connect with our order, inventory, and fulfillment systems.

* Develop interactive UI components using React and JavaScript to support our global Sales, Customer Service, and Logistics teams.

* Collaborate with back-end developers to integrate front-end applications with .NET APIs and services.

* Identify and resolve bugs across our web applications, ensuring consistent cross-browser and cross-device functionality.

* Analyze current front-end solutions and build enhancements to improve performance, usability, and maintainability.



Basic Requirements:



* Verifiable English language and writing skills.

* Available to work 8:00am – 5:00pm (PST/PDT).

* A minimum of 2 years professional work experience in front-end web development.

* Strong proficiency with React, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3.

* Hands-on experience building or customizing Shopify themes and/or Shopify apps (Liquid, Storefront API, or Shopify Functions).

* Working knowledge of .NET Core and C# for API integration and full-stack collaboration.

* Experience with relational databases such as MS SQL or MySQL.

title: Project Manager — eCommerce Team Operations & KPI Management (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
Location: Remote Schedule: Full-time, daily availability required Company: Fast-growing eCommerce brand (DTC)



About the Role



We're a fast-scaling eCommerce brand with a full team behind it — video editors, media buyers, customer service agents, and more. We're looking for a Project Manager who will be the operational backbone of the entire team.



Your job: make sure everyone does their tasks, hits their KPIs, and keeps up with the volume we expect — every single day. You'll own the creative pipeline from end to end, track every tea
mber's output, chase down anything that's falling behind, and make sure nothing (and nobody) slips through the cracks.



This is a hands-on, daily execution role for someone who is highly structured, highly organized, and genuinely enjoys keeping people accountable.



What You'll Do

- Own the Creative Pipeline

- Oversee the full creative production pipeline — from video editors delivering creatives to those creatives being launched

- Make sure every tea
mber completes their tasks on time and at the expected volume

- Identify bottlenecks early and solve them before they slow the team down



KPI Tracking & Reporting

- Track the KPIs of every tea
mber — video editors, customer service, media buyers, and beyond

- Check daily/weekly reports from each tea
mber and verify the numbers

- Send reminders and follow-ups so nobody forgets a task or misses a deadline

- Report team performance and blockers to leadership



Bonus & Incentive Management

- Manage our KPI-based bonus systems (e.g., video editors have clear monthly KPIs)

At the end of each month, verify who hit their KPIs and make sure every tea
mber receives the bonus they earned — accurately and on time



Goal Setting Across Teams

- Set and enforce clear, measurable goals per department. Examples of what this looks like:

- Customer Service: bring average response time down to 6 hours; collect 2 Trustpilot reviews every day

- Customer Service / Marketing: ensure we're consistently collecting UGC videos and video reviews from customers



Video Editors: maintain creative output volume and quality standards

- Follow up daily to make sure these targets are actually being hit — not just written down



What We're Looking For

- Proven experience as a Project Manager for an eCommerce brand — you understand creative pipelines, customer service operations, and performance marketing teams

- Extremely structured and organized — systems, checklists, and follow-ups are second nature to you

- Daily availability — this team runs every day, and so does this role

- Experience managing remote teams and holding people accountable in a positive but firm way

- Confident working with tools like Slack, Notion, and similar project management / communication tools

- Comfortable with numbers — checking reports, verifying KPIs, calculating bonus eligibility

- Proactive communicator — you chase answers, you don't wait for them

- Excellent written English



Nice to Have

- Experience with creative production workflows (video editing pipelines, ad creative volume)

- Experience setting up or improving KPI dashboards and reporting systems in Notion

- Familiarity with customer service tools and review platforms (Trustpilot, etc.)



Why Join Us

- Central role in a scaling eCommerce brand — the whole team runs through you

- Clear ownership and real responsibility from day one

- Work with an ambitious, high-volume team with clear systems and clear targets

- Long-term, stable full-time position with room to grow into an operations leadership role



How to Apply



Send us:



- A short intro about yourself and your project management experience (specifically with eCommerce brands)

- The team size and departments you've managed before

- Examples of KPI systems or accountability systems you've built or run

- Which tools you've used (Slack, Notion, ClickUp, Asana, etc.)

- Your daily availability and timezone



Start your application with the word "PIPELINE" so we know you read the full post.

title: Product Researcher for Growing US E-commerce Brand Portfolio (Full-Time)
description:
PRODUCT RESEARCHER



We are a US-based e-commerce company operating a growing portfolio of subscription brands (12+ live brands, launching 2 new brands every month). Every new brand starts with one decision: what product it sells. That decision is this job.



You will be part of our New Build Team — a small 4-person team that takes brands from zero to launched. You find and validate the product. Our brand designer, product specialist, and web developer build everything around your pick.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Research and source product opportunities (AliExpress, supplier catalogs, trend research, competitor analysis)

- Run every candidate through our validation checklist: demand signal, profit margin at target retail price, subscription fit, supplier availability

- Recommend ONE product per launch slot with clear reasoning, and write short "kill memos" explaining why the other candidates lost

- Keep a pipeline of researched candidates ready so we never miss a launch

- Work with our on-the-ground supplier team to confirm availability and costs



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Experience with e-commerce product research (dropshipping, Shopify, or Amazon research backgrounds all welcome)

- You can commit to a recommendation and defend it with numbers — this role bets real launch budgets on your picks

- Comfortable with spreadsheets (Google Sheets)

- Strong written English

- Organized, self-directed, and consistent — we launch on a schedule, not on inspiration



WHAT WE OFFER



- $900-$1,500/month depending on experience

- Full-time, long-term role with a fast-growing company (we plan to be at 100+ brands)

- Performance bonus tied to launch quality

- Clear checklist-based process — you will always know exactly what a winning recommendation looks like

- 13th month pay



HOW TO APPLY



1. Start your application with the word MOCHI so we know you read this far.

2. Tell us about one product YOU would sell as a subscription and why, in 5 sentences or less.

3. Include your experience with product research and any tools you have used.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a PAID trial project (real research task with our actual checklist) before any interview. The trial is the interview.

title: SENIOR CREATIVE LEAD / CREATIVE DIRECTOR — FASHION DTC (ADS, BRAND, CONTENT, UGC)
description:
SENIOR CREATIVE LEAD / CREATIVE DIRECTOR — FASHION DTC (ADS, BRAND, CONTENT, UGC)

Senior, hands-on creatives only · Fashion e-commerce · Remote · Long-term · Leadership role



Please read this entire post before applying. We screen carefully and ignore generic applications. If you follow the instructions at the bottom exactly, you will stand out. If you don't, we'll know you didn't read it.





WHO WE ARE



We operate a growing portfolio of e-commerce fashion brands. We run a real operation — a media buying function, a finance & analytics function, and documented systems for how the work gets done. Our creative is currently lean, and we're ready to invest in it properly. This is a chance to build and lead the creative engine for a scaling brand portfolio.





THE ROLE



We're hiring a Senior Creative Lead to take ownership of our entire creative function across all brands — and to elevate it. You'll be a hands-on maker AND a director: you'll personally produce high-quality creative, set the bar, and lead our existing creative tea
mber while we grow the department around you.



This is a senior leadership seat. You're not taking orders on individual assets — you're owning creative strategy and output across ads, brand, content, and UGC, and making our brands look and feel premium while driving performance.





WHAT YOU'LL OWN



- Performance ad creative (static + video) for Meta, TikTok, and Google — the creative that actually drives sales, working closely with our media buyers

- Brand identity and design systems across our portfolio — keeping each brand consistent, premium, and distinct

- Content and UGC direction — concepting, briefing, and producing scroll-stopping content

- Creative direction and leadership — setting standards, directing our current creative tea
mber, and building the department as it grows

- Turning performance feedback into better creative — you'll get clear data on what's working and iterate



WHAT THIS MEANS DAY TO DAY



- You both MAKE the work (design, edit, produce) and DIRECT it (brief, review, raise the bar)

- You translate brand and performance goals into creative that converts

- You manage and mentor our junior creative, and help us hire as we scale





WHO YOU ARE (HARD REQUIREMENTS)



Do not apply unless ALL of these are true. This is a senior role — we are not training you on the fundamentals of design or creative direction.



- Senior, hands-on creative skill — you personally produce high-quality ad creative, brand design, and content. Strong in the actual tools (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects / Premiere or equivalent, Figma, Canva, etc.)

- Proven FASHION / apparel creative experience — you understand fashion aesthetics, trends, and what makes apparel sell. General graphic design is not the same thing

- Performance creative experience — you've made ad creative for paid social (Meta/TikTok) that was measured on results, not just "looked nice." You understand hooks, angles, and what stops the scroll

- Leadership / direction experience — you've led, directed, or mentored other creatives, or clearly run creative as the senior person on a team

- Range across ads, brand, AND content/UGC — not just one lane

- Strong written English and the communication skills to lead remotely



You are NOT a fit if: you're a junior or mid designer looking to "grow into" a lead role, you only do brand work (no performance ad creative), you've never worked with fashion, you only make static templates, or you've never directed/led other creatives. This is a senior, take-charge seat.





NICE TO HAVE



- Experience building or scaling a creative team or department

- Subscription / membership fashion brand experience

- Comfort directing UGC creators and editing UGC into performance ads

- A point of view on premium / "stealth luxury" fashion aesthetics





HOW WE WORK / WHAT YOU GET



- Real ownership of the creative function across a growing brand portfolio

- A media buying team that gives you clear performance feedback so you know what's working

- A finance & analytics function and documented systems — a real operation, not chaos

- An existing tea
mber to lead from day one, and budget to grow the department

- Long-term, senior, ongoing work with room to build something





HOW TO APPLY (FOLLOW EXACTLY)



Applications that don't follow these steps are rejected automatically. This is the first test of whether you read and follow instructions.



Start your application with this code word: RUNWAY

(This confirms you actually read the post. No code word = no reply.)



Then include all of the following:



1. PORTFOLIO — A link to your portfolio. We want to see fashion ad creative, brand work, and content/UGC. This is the single most important thing — lead with your strongest fashion + performance work.



2. FASHION + PERFORMANCE PROOF — Name 1-2 fashion brands you've made creative for, what you personally produced, and (if you can) a result it drove — e.g. an ad/creative that scaled, beat control, or lifted performance. Real specifics, not "I improved engagement."



3. LEADERSHIP — Describe a time you led, directed, or mentored other creatives, or ran creative as the senior person. We need someone who can take charge, not just execute.



4. THE SCREENING QUESTION — Our media buyer tells you a fashion brand's top-performing ad is fatiguing (CPA rising, frequency climbing). What's your creative process for replacing it with something that performs? (We want to see how you actually think.)



5. LOGISTICS — Your expected monthly rate, weekly availability, and timezone.





A NOTE ON SERIOUSNESS



We run a real, structured operation and we're ready to invest in a senior creative who can elevate everything we make. In return we expect a proven, take-charge creative — not someone hoping to grow into the role. If that's you, show us your best work. If you're mass-applying, please skip this one.

Then include all of the following:



1. PLATFORMS — Confirm which of Meta, TikTok, and Google you've personally run, and for how long on each.



2. FASHION PROOF — Name 1-2 fashion / apparel brands you've run ads for, what your role was, and specifically a result you drove (e.g. "scaled X brand from $Y to $Z/day at a $___ CPA"). Real numbers, not "I improved performance."



3. SCREENING QUESTION — If I gave you a fashion brand with a target NCPA (new customer cost per acquisition) of $40, and an ad set had spent $120 with 1 purchase, what would you do and why? (We want to see how you actually think.)



4. LOGISTICS — Your expected monthly rate, your weekly availability, and your timezone.



5. PROOF — A link to a portfolio, case studies, screenshots of past account performance, or anything that proves the above. Claims without proof carry little weight.





A NOTE ON SERIOUSNESS



We run a real, structured operation and we invest in the people who join it. In return we expect proven operators who take the work seriously. If that's you, we'd love to see your application. If you're mass-applying, please skip this one.

title: Performance Creative Strategist
description:
Performance Creative Strategist (Paid Ads Creative + UGC/Content Management)

Full-Time • Remote • Long-Term



We are looking for a Performance Creative Strategist to create, manage, and optimize all paid ads creative across 3–4 DTC brands. This includes video ads, image ads, ad copy (headlines and primary text), creative concepts, and sourcing UGC creators. Your role is to consistently produce winning creatives that lower CAC and support daily ad spend scaling. We are not looking for generic Canva template designs. We need someone who understands direct-response creative and can produce original, performance-driven ads.



RESPONSIBILITIES



PAID ADS CREATIVE PRODUCTION

-Create and edit video ads for Meta and TikTok (UGC-style, testimonial, POV, problem/solution).

-Design static image ads, carousels, graphics, and thumbnails (not basic Canva templates).

-Write primary text, headlines, and descriptions for paid ads.

-Develop hooks, angles, and creative concepts based on product benefits and customer psychology.

-Produce 10–20 creative variations per week across video and image formats.



UGC CREATOR SOURCING AND MANAGEMENT

-Find and evaluate UGC creators who match brand needs.

-Provide clear briefs, shot lists, examples, and messaging direction.

-Ensure creators deliver raw footage on time and with usable quality.

-Organize and maintain a library of UGC clips and assets for future editing.



CREATIVE STRATEGY AND ITERATION

-Review creative performance data (CTR, CPC, thumbstop rate, CPA).

-Identify which hooks and themes perform best and create improved variations.

-Maintain a consistent creative testing pipeline with the media buyer.

-Propose new concepts and angles based on data and platform trends.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

-Consistent CAC improvement across brands.

-Stronger CTR and thumbstop performance.

-Reliable weekly output of new creatives ready for testing.

-Smooth UGC sourcing pipeline with dependable footage flow.

-Clean organization and structured workflow.



REQUIREMENTS

-Experience creating direct-response ads for Meta or TikTok.

-Strong video editing skills (CapCut, Adobe Premiere, Final Cut, etc.).

-Ability to design high-quality static ads (Figma, Photoshop, or Canva with customization).

-Ability to write compelling short-form ad copy (hooks, headlines, primary text).

-Understanding of direct-response psychology and high-performing ad structure.

-Highly organized and able to manage creative production across multiple brands.

-Must produce original work, not generic templates.



NICE TO HAVE

-Experience working with DTC brands.

-Familiarity with performance metrics such as CTR, CPC, CPA, and MER.

-Experience managing UGC creators or influencers.



COMPENSATION

-Competitive monthly salary based on experience.

-Performance bonuses for top-performing creatives.



TO APPLY

Please submit the following:

-Portfolio of video ads and static ads you personally created.

-A brief explanation of your creative process.

-Your expected monthly salary.

title: College Outreach Specialist
description:
About ATOZ Solutions



ATOZ Solutions runs campus flyer distribution for advertisers: physical flyers delivered under dorm room doors by a network of student contractors. Think of it as an Uber-style model, flyers to students, done by students. We currently operate on 18 campuses along the East Coast and are expanding our student contractor network.



The Role



You will be the engine behind our campus recruiting. Your job is to find student clubs and organizations at our target schools, find their contact
s, and reach out to see whether they or their members are interested in paid work distributing flyers on their campus. You will start with 5 or 6 assigned schools and grow to around 10 as you build a rhythm. This is ongoing daily work, not a one-off project.



What You Will Do Every Day



1. Research clubs. Identify student organizations at your assigned schools using club directories, school websites, social media, and any other source you can find.

2. Find contact
s. Collect
 addresses for clubs, e-boards, and individual student leaders. Any
 connected to a group of students, or a single student who could spread the word, counts.

3. Send outreach
s. Use our provided templates to contact each club or student about paid distribution work for their members.

4. Handle replies and follow-ups. Answer questions using the response guide we provide, and follow up with anyone who has not responded on a set schedule.

5. Write an end-of-day report. Every day you will submit a short report listing every club contacted,
s found, responses received, and anything that needs my attention.



What We Provide



- A list of target schools (starting with 5 or 6, expanding to about 10)

-
 templates for first touches and follow-ups

- A response guide covering the questions clubs and students commonly ask

- A simple report template and tracking sheet



Daily Expectations



- About 4 focused hours per day, on your own schedule within ET business hours

- After your first training week, a minimum of 25 new clubs contacted per day (researched,
 found, outreach sent)

- Same-day replies to any club or student who writes back

- End-of-day report submitted before you sign off, every working day



I review the daily reports closely. Consistent output is how this role continues and how additional hours open up; hours beyond 20 per week are offered based on results, not automatic.



Who This Fits



- Strong written English: your
s represent us to student leaders

- Organized and self-directed: you will manage your own daily pipeline across multiple schools

- Comfortable with repetitive research: much of this job is digging through club directories and finding
s

- Reliable: this runs every weekday, and the daily report is non-negotiable

- Basic spreadsheet skills (Google Sheets)

- Bonus: current college student or recent grad who knows how campus clubs operate

HOW TO APPLY (read carefully):

title: Executive Search Operator (Contract, Remote — Philippines)
description:
Company: MissFit Coaching in Chicago USA 

Location: Remote (Philippines-based)

Engagement: Independent contractor, full-time hours

Reports to: David Sho, Customer Success



About MissFit

MissFit Coaching is a boutique reverse-recruiting and executive career strategy firm. We work with senior white-collar professionals — many in active job transitions — to run their job search the way a search firm runs a client mandate: proactive targeting, hidden-market outreach, and disciplined pipeline management, not just resume tweaks and job board applications. Our founder is an ICF-PCC certified coach with 30 years of corporate HR and executive search experience.



The Role

We're hiring a senior-level executive search professional to execute reverse-recruiting operations for our clients — director, VP, and C-suite candidates navigating their own search. This is not an admin or sourcing-support role. You will run the tactical work of an executive search: mapping target companies, identifying decision-makers, building outreach sequences, and managing candidate positioning with the same rigor a retained search firm applies to a client mandate — just pointed in the opposite direction, in service of the candidate.



You'll execute against MissFit's documented playbooks and systems, working within our Customer Success team under David Sho. This is a system-driven operation, not a loose freelance gig — you'll work inside our proprietary 
ntum Maximizer tracking system, our Fit Finder scoring standard, and our daily team rhythm (Slack standups, commit cards, go-live QA gates), with clear process and real infrastructure behind you.



What You'll Do

Build and execute target company and contact lists for clients at the director-to-C-suite level, using tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Apollo



Identify hiring signals (leadership changes, funding events, org shifts) that indicate real, timely opportunity — not just open postings



Draft outreach messaging and positioning copy in the client's voice, calibrated to executive-level readers



Manage and maintain client search trackers (our proprietary 
ntum Maximizer system) with complete, accurate, and current data



Score and evaluate job opportunities against client fit criteria



Flag stalled searches, missed follow-ups, and networking gaps before they become client-facing problems



Communicate search progress and strategy clearly, in writing, to both clients and internal team



What You Will Never Do

These are firm, non-negotiable boundaries at MissFit — if your prior search experience relies on any of these, this role will require you to work differently:



Never log into or request a client's LinkedIn credentials



Never send messages or applications as if you are the client



Never submit an application without prior approval



Never negotiate directly with an employer on a client's behalf



Never guarantee a client outcome, timeline, or offer



What You Bring

7+ years in executive search, retained recruiting, or leadership hiring — ideally with direct experience at the director-level-and-above mandate tier, not just mid-level or volume recruiting



Strong command of written English — clear, professional, no filler, no AI-generated phrasing. You'll be asked to write in a client's voice, and your own writing sample is part of how we evaluate you



Working fluency with LinkedIn Recruiter/Sales Navigator, Apollo, or comparable sourcing and intelligence tools



Comfort with confidential, high-stakes work — you're often handling someone's livelihood and reputation



Reliable, detail-oriented, and able to work independently against a documented process without heavy oversight



Based in the Philippines, able to work hours with meaningful overlap with U.S. Central Time, we have staff in Nigeria, Pakistan and the Phillipines already. 



Comfort operating inside a defined system (trackers, scoring standards, daily standups) rather than an unstructured freelance workflow



How You're Measured

Once onboarded, your performance is tracked on two KPIs: client satisfaction and client renewal. Renewals earn you a bonus — your work is judged on whether clients stay and succeed, not on activity volume alone.



How We Evaluate Candidates

Our hiring process is deliberately rigorous because the work is high-trust. Expect:



Three short written screening answers (under 200 words each, no AI tools)



A one-minute unscripted video introduction



A short interview



A paid trial engagement before any ongoing contract is confirmed



Why This Role

This is a chance to do real executive search work — high-caliber and outcome-driven — in a fully remote contract role with a U.S.-based firm, working alongside a 30-year executive search and HR veteran. Strong performers have a path to higher-scope responsibility over time.



To Apply - READ THIS CAREFULLY - 

 your resume and a brief intro video (unscripted, one minute) to 
 with the subject line: "Executive Search Operator."

title: GoHighLevel Automation VA — Build From Detailed Spec (Workflows + Lead Scoring)
description:
I run a mortgage and real estate business and I have a GoHighLevel sub-account that's partly built — the pipelines are done, but the automations aren't. I need an experienced GHL builder to finish "Phase 1" and get the system actually working.



You will NOT be designing anything. I will hand you a complete, click-by-click build spec. Your job is to execute it exactly and prove each piece works. If you like clear instructions and hate guessing, this is the job for you.



What you'll build (five milestones, in order):



Custom fields (I'll give you the exact list)

Tag library (exact names provided)

Three workflows — missed-call text-back, after-hours responder, 45-minute gap bot

ManyChat ? GHL integration (5 DM flows that create tagged contacts)

Lead-scoring workflow (points for opens/clicks/replies that tag contacts hot/warm and route them)



How we work:

? Milestone-based. I pay after each milestone is built AND tested on a screen-share with me. No large deposit.

? Every milestone has a written test built into the spec. You run it, I watch, then I pay.

? Full documentation is provided. This is execution, not strategy.



You MUST have hands-on GoHighLevel experience building WORKFLOWS and LEAD SCORING — not just general GHL admin work.



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully — I ignore applications that skip this):



Start your reply with the word AUTOMATION so I know you read the whole post.

In 2–3 sentences, describe ONE lead-scoring or missed-call-text-back workflow you personally built in GHL — what triggered it and what it did.

Tell me: are you comfortable screen-sharing to test each piece before payment? (Yes/No)



Applications without the keyword and a real workflow example will not be reviewed.

title: Creative Strategist — DTC Supplement Brands (Full-Time)
description:
Summary

999 Supplements is the parent company behind a portfolio of fast-growing DTC supplement brands sold across the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand. We build direct-response brands rooted in deep customer research, sharp positioning, and a relentless testing cadence on Meta. We're not a generalist e-commerce shop — every brand we run is engineered around a specific avatar, a specific angle, and a specific desire.



The role



We're looking for a Creative Strategist to own our winning-ad pipeline end to end. Your job is simple to describe and hard to do well: find what's working in the market, understand why it's working, and reverse-engineer it into ads that win for our brands.

You'll work directly with the founder and a team of video editors. You won't be cutting video yourself — you'll be the brain that d
 what gets made, for whom, and why.



What you'll actually do



Research the avatar, angle, and desire. For each brand, you'll go deep on who we're selling to, what stage of awareness they're in (Schwartz's awareness ladder is the operating system here), and what language they actually use to describe their problem — pulled from real voice-of-customer sources, not assumptions.

Hunt winning creatives. Daily/weekly sweeps of
 Ads Library across direct and indirect competitors, sorted by highest impressions. You'll know which ads are scaling, which mechanisms are getting traction, and which hooks keep showing up.

Transcribe and reverse-engineer. You'll pull scripts from winning competitor ads, feed them through our brief-writing process (with research docs, avatar docs, and product context as inputs), and produce briefs our editors can actually execute on.

Track everything. Every tested creative goes into our Growth Guide '25 spreadsheet. Every brief becomes a Notion card with proper naming conventions and brief links. You own this hygiene — if it's not tracked, it didn't happen.

Rinse and repeat. This is a volume game with a quality floor. Weekly briefs, weekly tests, weekly learnings, weekly iteration.

What we're looking for



2+ years writing direct-response briefs or scripts for DTC brands, ideally supplements, health, or beauty

Native-level fluency in Meta ad creative — you can watch a UGC ad and tell us in 30 seconds why it's working

Working knowledge of the awareness ladder, problem/solution/product awareness, and how to write for each stage

Comfortable with research-heavy workflows: scraping reviews, lurking in
 groups and forums, finding the exact phrase a customer uses before they know what's wrong with them

Organized. Notion, Google Sheets, and clean naming conventions are non-negotiable

Writes fast, writes clearly, takes feedback without ego

Bonus: experience with VSLs, advertorials, or presell pages



What you won't be doing



Posting to organic social

Designing graphics or editing video

Running the ad accounts (you'll work closely with the buyer, but media buying isn't your job)



How we work

Our workflow is: Research ? Data Analysis ? Hypothesis ? Copy ? Test ? Feedback Loop ? Repeat. Friday is our weekly performance audit. We run lean, we move fast, and we expect everyone on the team to bring a point of view.



How to apply

Send the following to our inbox/message:



- A short note on the best DTC ad you've seen this month and why it works (3–5 sentences, no fluff)

- A link or attachment of one brief or script you've written that produced results — include the metrics if you have them

- Short Loom video where you explain what creative strategy is and if you have experience. So you can explain everything here

- Your CV or portfolio



Applications without #1 and #2 and #3 won't be reviewed.

title: SENIOR AMAZON PPC MANAGER
description:
SENIOR AMAZON PPC MANAGER



LOCATION: Remote, Philippines preferred

TYPE: Part-time to start, approximately 20-30 hours per week

COMPENSATION: $10-18USD/hr, Based on experience and agreed scope



OVERVIEW



Leaven Marketing is a small Amazon agency built on referrals, not cold outreach. We are a high-trust team, with our core team based in the Philippines, the Founder based in Europe, and most clients in the US. Every client is a personal relationship, and we want the same from the people who join us.



We are looking for a Senior Amazon PPC Manager to lead advertising strategy and execution across multiple client brands and marketplaces. You will independently diagnose account and business problems, set direction, make budget and growth decisions, communicate recommendations to leadership and clients, and take full ownership of results.



This is not a PPC operator role. We are not looking for someone who only follows SOPs, adjusts bids, builds campaigns, or reports metrics. We need a senior manager who can d
 what should be done, explain why, and ensure it is executed correctly.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



• Own PPC strategy and execution across multiple Amazon brands and marketplaces

• Set the strategic direction for each account rather than waiting for tasks or instructions

• Build growth plans and budgets based on client goals, product stage, competition, margins, inventory, and seasonality

• Make independent recommendations on growth, budgets, profitability, ranking, and risk

• Launch, manage, and optimize SP, SB, SBV, and SD campaigns

• Own targeting, bids, placements, budgets, search terms, campaign structure, and testing

• Diagnose performance across advertising, organic sales, listings, products, and market conditions

• D
 when to scale, defend, rank, test, increase spend, or reduce risk

• Turn complex account data into clear business decisions and priorities

• Deliver concise reporting focused on what happened, why it matters, and what happens next

• Proactively surface risks, opportunities, and required decisions

• Lead PPC discussions with internal teams and clients when needed

• Align PPC with SEO, creative, catalog, promotions, and inventory

• Take accountability for portfolio performance, not only campaign execution

• Use AI or automation to extend capacity while retaining full responsibility for accuracy, judgment, and decisions



YOU’RE A FIT IF YOU



• Have already operated as the senior decision-maker on Amazon PPC accounts, not only as an executor

• Can lead strategy, challenge assumptions, and defend recommendations with commercial reasoning

• Are comfortable owning outcomes across multiple clients without close supervision

• Take proactive ownership, think commercially, and act without waiting for direction

• Make clear, data-backed decisions and communicate risks, mistakes, or blockers early

• Are curious, coachable, and comfortable having your recommendations challenged

• Have 4–6+ years of hands-on Amazon PPC experience, ideally managing multiple agency accounts

• Have proven success with launches, ranking, scaling, and profitability

• Are advanced in SP, SB, SBV, SD, targeting, placements, bulk operations, Brand Analytics, and Search Query Performance

• Can build budgets and forecasts from business inputs

• Have strong Google Sheets skills and clear client-facing English



BONUS POINTS



• Amazon DSP, AMC, or Attribution experience

• Experience building responsible AI-assisted PPC workflows

• Experience with Pacvue, Perpetua, Scale Insights, Adtomic, or similar tools

• Broader Amazon SEO, creative, catalog, inventory, or operations knowledge



CULTURE AND WORKFLOW



• Async-first using ClickUp, Slack, and Google Drive

• Flexible hours with some CEST overlap

• High ownership and zero micromanagement

• No time tracking or clocking hours; we trust that the work gets done

• High standards delivered kindly

• Small team where people are known personally, not treated as anonymous output



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



• Your resume

• A short written introduction

• Your current availability and expected compensation

• One specific example of an account you grew, including the measurable result

• A link to a two-minute video answering the following questions:



       1. Who are you, and what is your current work situation?

       2. Why do you want this specific role at Leaven Marketing?

       3. What type of team helps you do your best work?



! Please speak naturally and do not read from a script. The video helps us assess your English communication, motivation, self-awareness, and understanding of the role.



Applications without a video will not be considered.



Applications focused mainly on campaign setup, bid optimization, keyword management, or following established instructions will not be considered. This role requires proven senior ownership of strategy, budgets, growth decisions, communication, and results.



INTERVIEW PROCESS



• Submit your resume and two-minute video introduction

• Join a 30-minute introductory call focused on role and culture fit

• Complete a practical PPC skills assessment

• Join a follow-up call to walk through your assessment, reasoning, and decisions

title: Senior Graphics & Packaging Designer
description:
Full-time | 40 hours/week | $2,000 USD/month + 13th Month Pay | Immediate Start



**ABOUT US**

Intent Brands owns two growing consumer brands sold through Amazon and Shopify: SurviveX, a premium first aid and emergency preparedness brand, and Aerotrunk, a premium hardside luggage brand.



**THE ROLE**

We're looking for a senior-level designer who can own the visual output of both brands, from retail packaging and Amazon A+ content to ecommerce and social media, with minimal supervision.



**What You'll Do**

-Design retail packaging, inserts, labels and production-ready artwork

-Create Amazon listing images, infographics and A+ Content

-Design Amazon Brand Store and Shopify assets

-Create social media and marketing graphics

-Retouch, composite and art-direct product imagery

-Maintain and evolve both brands' visual identities



***What We're Looking For**

We're not looking for someone who simply knows Photoshop. We want a designer with a portfolio that makes us want to hire them immediately.





***MUST HAVE**

1.) Real retail packaging experience that has gone to print

2.) Strong knowledge of dielines, bleeds, safe zones, spot colours and substrates

3.) Amazon listing and A+ Content experience

4.) Strong print-production knowledge: CMYK, Pantone, PDF/X and press-ready files

5.) Advanced Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign skills

6.) Excellent typography, layout and visual hierarchy

7.) Strong written English and ability to work independently



**BONUS/ NICE TO HAVE**

-After Effects / motion graphics

-Blender / Dimension / 3D

-Midjourney, DALL-E, Stable Diffusion or similar

-Figma

-Medical or health product packaging experience

-FDA/regulatory labelling experience



***PLEASE ANSWER ALL THE FOUR QUESTIONS**

TAKE NOTE: Include the phrase "I Design For Production" of the first line your application. This tells us you've read the full listing.



IMPORTANT: Please include links to your portfolio or relevant work, along with your responses to the following questions:



QUESTION #1.) Show us one packaging project you're particularly proud of that went into physical production.

Please tell us:

What was the product?

What were the print specifications and constraints?

What was your process from concept through final artwork?

Can you show the physical printed product alongside your design?

**Share us the link of it. Actual printed products are strongly preferred over mockups.**



QUESTION #2.) Amazon Design Challenge

Choose one scenario:

*Option A: Our first aid kit's main Amazon image has a 3% click-through rate, compared with a category average of 4.5%. The current image is a straightforward product shot on white.

*Option B: We're launching a new luggage product and need seven Amazon listing images.

What would you change, and why? What would you A/B test first?

What would you put in each image slot, and why?



We're interested in your thinking, not just your final design.



QUESTION #3.) Two Very Different Brands:

SurviveX is medical/tactical: red, black, authoritative and confident.

Aerotrunk is modern, premium and aspirational, with a travel/lifestyle focus.



How would you design for two very different brands without making them feel like the work of the same brand?

Give us a specific technique, process or example from your experience.



QUESTION #4.) Your Tools & Workflow

Tell us your complete design stack.

For each major tool, tell us whether you use it: Daily | Weekly | Occasionally

Also tell us your typical turnaround time for creating a complete set of seven Amazon listing images, from brief to final delivery.



***SHORT-LISTED APPLICANTS WILL ADVANCED TO OUR PAID DESIGN TEST**

We believe the best way to evaluate a designer is to look at their actual work.

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a paid design test ($100 USD) instead of going through multiple rounds of interviews.



The test will involve:

Redesigning three existing SurviveX Amazon listing images

Creating a front-and-back packaging insert based on a supplied dieline and brief

We'll provide the brand guidelines, existing assets and a clear brief.



We'll be evaluating: Design quality, Brand interpretation, Commercial thinking , Production readiness, Attention to detail, Turnaround speed



********WE OFFER THE BEST DEAL!!!********

SALARY: $2,000 USD/month

Paid biweekly via direct deposit.



13th Month Pay: Standard Philippine benefit.

Paid Time Off: Philippine holidays plus 15 days of personal leave.



Creative Ownership: You'll have genuine influence over how two growing brands look and communicate.

Small, Direct Team: You'll work closely with the founders without layers of middle management.

Room to Grow: As the brands grow, there's potential to progress into a Design Lead or Creative Director role.



***HOW TO APPLY***

Please include all of the following:

Answers to all four screening questions

The phrase "I design for production"

A link to your portfolio

At least two examples of physical product packaging you designed

Your expected rate and availability



Your portfolio can be on Behance, Dribbble, your own website, Google Drive or another platform. We care about the work, not where you host it.



**Applications without a portfolio or completed screening questions will not be reviewed.**

We aim to review applications within 48 hours. Shortlisted candidates will receive the paid design test within one week.



THANK YOU AND WE ARE LOOKING FORWARD TO SEE YOUR APPLICATIONS!

title: AMAZON GRAPHIC DESIGNER - FULL TIME EST
description:
About the Role



FESCO is a consumer goods company that sources and sells branded products across Amazon, Walmart, and Target under licensed brands including CAR&DRIVER, COBY, and PERRY ELLIS. We are looking for a talented and results-driven Graphic Designer who understands the Amazon marketplace inside and out.



This is not a traditional design role. You will be responsible for creating product listings that convert browsers into buyers. That means understanding how to lead with benefits over features, write visual hierarchy that mirrors how shoppers scan Amazon pages, and produce assets that perform against competitors. You will own the full visual output for new product launches and ongoing listing optimization.



Key Responsibilities



Amazon Listing Design



• Design main images, secondary images, and infographic sets for Amazon product detail pages across all active categories

• Build A+ Content (EBC) modules that tell a clear brand story and reinforce purchase confidence

• Translate raw product specs and factory data into customer-facing benefit statements that are visually communicated through icons, callouts, and comparison charts

• Optimize listing visuals for both desktop and mobile views, following Amazon's current image requirements and best practices



Marketing & Brand Design



• Create on-brand advertising creatives for Sponsored Brand, Sponsored Display, and DSP campaigns

• Produce lifestyle imagery concepts, flat-lay compositions, and product mockups to supplement factory photos

• Design promotional graphics for seasonal events (Prime Day, Black Friday, Back to School) that are consistent across all channels

• Support brand licensing requirements by ensuring all creative assets comply with licensor style guides (fonts, colors, logo usage)



Feature/Benefit Communication



• Partner with the product development team to deeply understand each product before designing, reviewing technical specs, competitive listings, and customer reviews to identify the most compelling selling points

• Convert feature lists (materials, dimensions, certifications) into benefit-driven visual messaging that answers the question "why does this matter to the customer?"

• Build comparison charts and competitive differentiator graphics that clearly position FESCO products against category competitors

• Ensure compliance callouts (certifications, safety information, warranty terms) are present and legible without disrupting visual flow



Workflow & Collaboration



• Manage multiple simultaneous product launches, prioritizing based on go-live timelines and pipeline status

• Work within shared SharePoint/OneDrive folders, maintaining clean file organization and version control

• Deliver editable layered source files (PSD, AI, or equivalent) for all completed assets

• Incorporate feedback from A/B testing and listing performance data to iterate on creative over time



Required Qualifications



• 3+ years of graphic design experience with a portfolio that includes Amazon product listings or e-commerce creative

• Demonstrated ability to translate product features and technical specs into clear, benefit-led visual content

• Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign at minimum)

• Solid understanding of Amazon image guidelines, A+ Content requirements, and listing anatomy

• Experience designing for both digital retail and paid advertising placements

• Ability to work independently, hit deadlines, and manage a multi-SKU workload without daily oversight

• Excellent attention to detail, especially with spacing, typography, and brand consistency



Preferred Qualifications



• Experience working with licensed brands and adhering to licensor brand guidelines

• Familiarity with Amazon PPC advertising creative formats including Sponsored Brand video assets

• Background in consumer electronics, home goods, or everyday essentials categories

• Understanding of Amazon's algorithm and how listing quality scores, keywords, and click-through rates relate to design decisions

• Experience with Canva or other scalable design tools for rapid creative iteration

• Basic photo editing and retouching skills to clean up factory or sample photos



What Success Looks Like



In the first 60 days, you will have designed complete image sets for at least 20 active product launches, built familiarity with our brand guidelines and licensed brand requirements, and delivered A+ Content for a priority SKU. Within six months, your work will be measurably impacting conversion rates, and you will be proactively flagging opportunities to improve underperforming listings based on your read of the competitive landscape.



What We Offer



• A fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with real ownership over creative output

• Exposure to multiple licensed brands across a diverse product catalog

• Competitive compensation based on experience

•      13th Month Bonus depending on output

• Flexible remote or hybrid work arrangement

• Direct collaboration with product development, sourcing, and Amazon channel management

title: Customer Support Representative – DTC Comfort Footwear Brand (US Market)
description:
The Brand

We're a fast-growing direct-to-consumer footwear brand designing comfort shoes for women aged 50+. Our shoes look normal — not medical, not clunky — just well-made shoes that happen to feel incredible. We sell primarily through our Shopify store, driven by paid social traffic (Meta ads).



Our customers are loyal when treated right and vocal when they're not. That's where you come in.



The Role

You are the voice of this brand during the morning shift. Every
 you send either builds trust or breaks it. You'll be our second CS representative, handling inbound customer
s through Gorgias — returns, exchanges, shipping questions, damaged items, cancellations, and the occasional angry customer threatening a chargeback.



You'll work closely with Erwin, our CS Manager, who oversees the team via Slack. He's your first point of contact for questions, edge cases, and anything above your escalation threshold — you're never guessing alone.



This is not a "copy-paste templates and hope for the best" role. You'll use proven templates and a custom AI copilot as your foundation, but you'll need the judgment to know when to personalize, when to escalate to Erwin, and when to issue a refund immediately to protect the brand.



Your core responsibilities

Clear overnight backlog within the first 2 hours of every shift

Handle live tickets with a target response time under 30 minutes

Triage urgent cases (cancellations, address changes, chargeback threats) immediately

Follow our structured refund ladder — 30% ? 50% ? full refund — with precision, within your authorized limit

Escalate any refund/replacement decision above your threshold to Erwin in Slack before acting

Process refunds and replacements in Gorgias/Shopify and log them in our master sheet

De-escalate frustrated customers before they become disputes

Generate Trustpilot reviews from happy customers using our two-method system

Submit a daily end-of-shift report in Slack — every single day, no exceptions



What "A-Player" Looks Like in This Role

You don't just respond — you resolve. Our target is ?4 messages per ticket on average. That means your first reply needs to be so clear and complete that the customer doesn't need to write back three more times.



You protect the brand from chargebacks. If someone mentions "dispute," "bank," "fraud," or "lawyer" — you don't negotiate. You refund immediately if it's within your authorized limit, or you flag Erwin in Slack right away if it's above it. Either way, it gets handled fast. A refund is always cheaper than a chargeback + fees + a hit to our payment processor reputation.



You follow the system. We have templates, decision trees, escalation rules, and a refund ladder for a reason. You don't freelance on refund amounts. You don't promise faster shipping. You don't skip the photo proof step on damaged items. The system works — your job is to execute it with empathy and precision, and to loop in Erwin the 
nt something falls outside your lane.



You generate reviews without being pushy. Our best review 
nts come from size exchanges where the customer keeps the original pair for free. You'll learn to spot the "wow" 
nts and use them strategically.



You communicate proactively with your manager. Erwin handles all team communication through Slack. If you see a recurring issue with no template, you flag it to him. If you're unsure how to handle something, you ask — you don't guess. If Disputifier sends a fraud alert, you report it to Erwin and wait for instructions.



Escalation & Authority

You can independently process refunds/replacements following the refund ladder up to [$XX] per order.

Anything above that threshold, or anything unusual (fraud flags, legal threats, repeat offenders, policy exceptions) goes to Erwin in Slack before you act.

title: Temporary Shopify & Loox Review Import Assistant
description:
Job type: Temporary project with the opportunity to become full-time

Schedule: Flexible

Expected project length: Approximately 1–2 weeks, depending on speed and accuracy



About the Project



The Room Collective is an online pet-supplies store built on Shopify. We need a careful and dependable assistant to locate the correct matching products on AliExpress and import their existing customer reviews into the corresponding Shopify products using Loox.



This is an entry-level position. Advanced design or marketing experience is not required. We will provide instructions, but you must be comfortable working carefully inside Shopify, Loox, and AliExpress.



Strong performance on this project may lead to ongoing or full-time work assisting with product listings, images, website organization, social media, and general e-commerce operations.



Responsibilities



You will:



Review The Room Collective’s Shopify product catalog

Locate the exact matching product or supplier listing on AliExpress

Confirm that the AliExpress product matches the Shopify product

Connect the correct AliExpress source page to the correct Shopify product

Import legitimate and relevant customer reviews using Loox’s approved import tools

Include customer photos and videos when available and relevant

Preserve the original review rating and content

Check imported reviews for incorrect products, variants, or images

Remove or flag obvious spam, duplicate reviews, broken content, or reviews for a different product

Check how the reviews appear on the live product page

Maintain a spreadsheet or tracker showing each completed product

Report products for which no reliable matching AliExpress listing can be found

Accuracy Requirements



The most important part of this job is matching reviews to the correct product.



You must not:



Import reviews from a similar but different product

Attach dog-product reviews to the wrong size, model, or design

Change negative reviews into positive ones

Change review ratings

Rewrite reviews to make them sound better

Create fake reviews

Invent customer names, photographs, purchases, or comments

Import supplier descriptions as customer reviews

Guess when the product match is uncertain



If you are not sure that two products match, flag the product for review instead of importing anything.



Product-Matching Checklist



Before importing reviews, confirm:



Product appearance

Function and intended use

Available sizes

Materials

Colors or patterns

Included components

Product photographs

Model or variation

Supplier description



A product does not qualify as an exact match simply because it looks similar.



Review Quality Check



After every import:



Open the Shopify product page.

Confirm that the reviews appear under the correct product.

Check review photos and videos for product accuracy.

Confirm that the rating and text imported correctly.

Check for duplicates or broken images.

Record the product as completed in the tracking sheet.

Add the AliExpress source URL used.



Import all legitimate reviews associated with the correct product. Do not selectively import only five-star reviews. Flag questionable, irrelevant, duplicated, or mismatched reviews for review.



Required Skills

Careful attention to detail

Basic Shopify knowledge

Ability to navigate AliExpress

Ability to follow written instructions

Reliable internet connection

Basic spreadsheet skills

Clear written English

Ability to work independently

Willingness to ask when a product match is genuinely uncertain



Previous Loox experience is helpful but not required. Training can be provided to the right person.



Performance Standards



You will be evaluated on:



Correct product matching

Accuracy of imported reviews

Number of products completed

Quality of recordkeeping

Ability to identify mismatched reviews

Communication

Reliability

Ability to follow instructions without taking unsafe shortcuts



Speed matters, but accuracy matters more. Importing hundreds of reviews into the wrong product creates more work than it saves.



Opportunity for Continued Work



This is initially a temporary assignment. A successful assistant may be offered ongoing or full-time e-commerce work involving:



Shopify product organization

Product listing cleanup

Image organization

Inventory checks

Website quality control

AliExpress and supplier research

Basic social-media support

Marketplace listing assistance

How to Apply



Begin your application with:



LOOX REVIEW ASSISTANT



Include:



Your experience with Shopify, Loox, AliExpress, or other e-commerce platforms

Whether you have previously imported product reviews

Your available hours per week

Your internet speed

Your requested hourly rate

Confirmation that you understand reviews must only be imported to the exact matching product

A short explanation of what you would do if you could not confirm an exact AliExpress product match



Generic applications that do not answer these questions will not be considered.

title: Direct Response Copywriter & Creative Strategist in one role for 7-8 Figure supplement brand
description:
Summary

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are a fast-scaling direct-to-consumer health brand looking for an elite, data-backed Direct-Response Copywriter & Creative Strategist. We are looking for an angle-hunter, a script-master, and a conversion-mechanic rolled into one.



We do not write generic, corporate marketing copy, nor do we build standard e-commerce funnels. We create high-stakes, logically airtight, direct-to-consumer health campaigns.



If you are the type of writer who relies on basic adjectives, template formats, and surface-level benefits, please do not apply. But if you actively breathe Eugene Schwartz’s Breakthrough Advertising principles, know exactly how to manipulate Market Sophistication and Awareness levels, and execute the RMBC Method flawlessly under tight deadlines, this role is engineered for you.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

End-to-End Creative Strategy & Ideation: You won’t just take orders; you will lead the creative direction. You will deep-dive into market research, analyze ad comments and forums, review customer data, and dream up completely fresh visual hooks and positioning angles to scale our media buying spend.



Write Category-Defining VSLs (~3-5 Minutes): You will craft high-retention, problem-aware video scripts utilizing psychological pattern-interrupts and visceral, real-world analogies. You must be able to pitch a severe physical crisis and bridge it seamlessly to a proprietary solution without losing the user's logic or trust.



Draft Long-Form Hybrid PDPs: You will reverse-engineer standard, boring e-commerce checkout pages and convert them into long-form editorial landing pages that seamlessly function as high-converting checkout carts.



Write Native Advertorials: You will script top-of-funnel presell articles that systematically dismantle mainstream band-aids and open a massive curiosity loop that drives massive clicks to our main offers.



REQUIRED SKILLS & STRATEGIC KNOWLEDGE

Mastery of Market Awareness & Sophistication: You understand how to market to a highly saturated, highly skeptical consumer base. You know how to take a Problem-Aware prospect (someone experiencing real physical symptoms but clueless about the underlying biological cause) and bypass their defensive walls by targeting a hidden, external enemy.



The RMBC Method (Research, Mechanism, Brief, Copy): This is non-negotiable. You must deeply understand how to isolate a Unique Mechanism of the Problem (UMP) and a Unique Mechanism of the Solution (UMS) to form a bulletproof, logical chain.



Simplification of Complex Science: You know how to take advanced biological concepts and translate them into clear, simple, punchy, real-world analogies (e.g., explaining bodily pipelines using concepts like plumbing, traffic jams, collapsed highways, or rusted pipes).



Visual Storyboarding: You write copy with the video editor in mind. Every line of your script must explicitly dictate a clear, second-by-second visual action, b-roll directive, or high-contrast text overlay to maximize video hold-rates.



QUALIFICATIONS

3+ years of verifiable direct-response copywriting and creative strategy experience in the supplement, health, longevity, or financial publishing verticals.



A portfolio showcasing winning VSLs, long-form landing pages, or advertorials that have generated consistent, profitable ROAS on cold traffic platforms (Meta, Google, YouTube).



Direct study or formal training in ancestral direct-response frameworks (Breakthrough Advertising, Stefan Georgi’s RMBC framework, or classic Agora-style copywriting models).



High speed of execution. You can research a bodily mechanism deeply, map out a full creative strategy brief, and execute a clean first draft efficiently without endless corporate hand-holding.



WHAT WE OFFER

Profitable Scaling Environment: Our media buying team is world-class. Your winning hooks, scripts, angles, and landing pages will immediately be backed by substantial daily ad spend.



ROAS Bonuses: When your copy and creative strategy wins, you win. We offer direct performance bonuses tied to scaling the conversion rates and average order values (AOV) of your campaigns.



Complete Creative Autonomy: No slow, painful corporate committees. We move fast, split-test aggressively, and rely entirely on what the data dictates.



TO APPLY:

Please send over a brief introduction outlining your experience with the RMBC method, your background in managing Creative Strategy, and 2-3 links to live or past direct-response assets (VSLs, PDPs, Advertorials, or ad briefs) that showcase your ability to convert cold traffic.

title: Nonprofit Grant Research and Application Specialist
description:
We are hiring an experienced Nonprofit Grant Research and Application Specialist to identify, evaluate, organize, draft, and manage grant opportunities for a U.S.-based nonprofit focused on financial wellness, economic mobility, workforce development, entrepreneurship, and community empowerment.



This is not a general virtual assistant role. You must understand how to research U.S. grant opportunities, determine true eligibility and funder alignment, write persuasive applications, manage deadlines, and organize supporting documents.



Your work must be accurate. You will never invent statistics, partnerships, program results, organizational history, budgets, credentials, or other information to complete an application.



Your Responsibilities



* Research grants from private foundations, corporations, banks, community foundations, and government agencies.

* Identify opportunities aligned with our mission, programs, location, target population, and organizational capacity.

* Review eligibility requirements before recommending that we apply.

* Evaluate each opportunity based on fit, competitiveness, funding amount, deadline, restrictions, and application workload.

* Maintain a complete grant prospect database and rolling 12-month grant calendar.

* Draft letters of inquiry, concept papers, grant applications, proposals, and follow-up responses.

* Write program descriptions, needs statements, goals, activities, outcomes, evaluation plans, and sustainability narratives.

* Customize every application to the funder instead of submitting generic proposals.

* Coordinate required attachments, including budgets, board information, policies, IRS documents, financial records, and program materials.

* Track application status, decisions, reporting deadlines, renewal dates, and funder communications.

* Maintain an organized library of approved organizational language and supporting documents.

* Research funder history, past grantees, geographic priorities, and typical award amounts.

* Clearly identify missing information before drafting unsupported answers.

* Submit applications only after receiving approval.

* Provide a weekly report showing opportunities researched, rejected, approved, drafted, submitted, and awaiting decisions.



Required Qualifications



* At least three years of grant research or grant-writing experience.

* Experience supporting U.S.-based nonprofit organizations.

* Strong written English with excellent grammar and attention to detail.

* Experience researching private foundation and corporate grants.

* Ability to distinguish basic eligibility from strong funder alignment.

* Experience managing several applications and deadlines at the same time.

* Ability to review lengthy guidelines and identify critical requirements.

* Strong organizational, research, fact-checking, and documentation skills.

* Experience developing grant calendars and prospect-tracking systems.

* Comfortable working independently and requesting clarification when information is missing.

* Reliable internet, computer, and professional workspace.

* Willingness to complete a paid skills assessment.



Preferred Experience



Preference will be given to applicants with experience in:



* Financial literacy or financial wellness

* Economic mobility

* Workforce development

* Career pathways

* Small-business development

* Entrepreneurship

* Community development

* Underserved communities

* Adult education

* Capacity-building grants

* Program development

* Grants.gov or SAM.gov

* Candid or Foundation Directory

* Instrumentl, GrantStation, Foundant or Submittable

* Google Drive, Google Docs, Google Sheets and project-management systems



Nonnegotiable Accuracy Standards



You must never:



* Guarantee that a grant will be awarded.

* Invent organizational facts, statistics, outcomes, partnerships, budgets or participant numbers.

* Submit an application without approval.

* Apply for opportunities that do not meet the eligibility requirements.

* Reuse generic language without adapting it to the funder.

* Present loans, contracts, sponsorships or tax credits as grants without clearly identifying the difference.

* use AI-generated content without reviewing every fact and statement.

* Hide missing information instead of requesting clarification.



Accuracy and funder alignment are more important than application volume.



Performance Expectations



You will be measured on:



* Quality of grant opportunities identified

* Accuracy of eligibility reviews

* Strength of funder alignment

* Quality of written applications

* Completion of applications before deadlines

* Organization of grant records and supporting documents

* Accuracy of submitted information

* Number of strong applications completed

* Reporting and follow-up management

* Communication, reliability, and attention to detail



You will not be evaluated solely on grants awarded because funders control final decisions. You will be evaluated on whether your work gives the organization the strongest reasonable opportunity to compete.



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. A brief introduction describing your nonprofit grant experience.

2. The number of years you have worked with U.S.-based nonprofits.

3. The types of grants you have researched or written.

4. The industries or nonprofit causes you have supported.

5. The grant-research databases and submission platforms you have used.

6. Two redacted grant-writing samples.

7. One example of a grant opportunity you advised an organization not to pursue and why.

8. A description of how you determine whether a nonprofit is competitive for a grant.

9. Your availability and preferred working hours.

10. Your expected hourly or monthly compensation.



Application Assessment



Qualified finalists will receive a paid skills assignment.



You will review a grant opportunity and prepare:



* An eligibility assessment

* A funder-alignment assessment

* A summary of required attachments

* Risks or missing information

* An apply, do not apply, or investigate recommendation

* A short draft project summary using only the information provided



Applications without relevant writing samples will not be considered.



Attention-to-Detail Requirement



To confirm that you read the entire job description, include the following phrase in the subject line of your application:



The color blue

Join One of Australia's Growing Specialist Finance Advisory Firms



Queensland Capital Solutions (QCS) is a rapidly growing Australian finance advisory firm specialising in residential lending, commercial finance, private lending, development finance and business funding solutions.



We work with homeowners, property investors, business owners, developers, accountants and professional advisers to structure funding solutions that extend well beyond traditional banking.



As our business continues to grow, we're looking for an experienced Senior Mortgage Operations Specialist to become a key member of our lending operations team.

You'll play an important role in maintaining the high service standards QCS has become known for while also supporting process improvement and mentoring junior team members.



Working closely with our Australian Lending Manager, you'll become a trusted operational partner to our brokers and a key contributor to the continued success of our business.

• Review loan files prior to submission

• Identify opportunities to improve internal systems and processes

• Contribute to the continued growth of our operations team

We're seeking an experienced Australian mortgage professional who has:

• Ideally, you'll have at least 3–5 years' experience supporting Australian mortgage brokers

• Extensive knowledge of Australian residential lending

• Experience managing loan applications from submission through settlement

• Strong understanding of Australian lender policies

• Experience using Mercury Nexus (highly regarded)

• Experience using ApplyOnline

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Outstanding organisational skills

• Exceptional attention to detail

• Ability to manage multiple applications simultaneously

• Strong problem-solving abilities

• Confidence working independently while collaborating within a team

________________________________________

Highly Regarded Experience



Experience with any of the following will be highly regarded:

• Commercial Lending

• Business Lending

• Private Lending

• Development Finance

• Construction Finance

• Asset Finance

• SMSF Lending

• Leadership or mentoring experience

________________________________________

What Success Looks Like



Within your first 12 months you'll become a trusted member of the Queensland Capital Solutions team by:

• Successfully managing a portfolio of lending applications

• Supporting Australian brokers with increasingly complex transactions

• Assisting in mentoring junior offshore staff

• Identifying opportunities to improve operational workflows

• Delivering an exceptional client experience

• Becoming a subject matter expert across multiple lending disciplines

________________________________________

Technology & Equipment



Queensland Capital Solutions believes our people should have the right tools to succeed.



We provide all business equipment required for the role, including:

• Company laptop

• Additional monitor

• Professional noise-cancelling headset

• Microsoft Office licence

• Microsoft Teams

• Mercury Nexus CRM

• ApplyOnline access

• Business software licences

• Security software and IT support



The only requirement is that you provide:

• Reliable high-speed internet connection (minimum 50 Mbps)

• Quiet, professional home office

• Backup internet connection (preferred)

________________________________________

What We Offer



• Starting from ?70,000 per month (Independent Contractor), with remuneration negotiable based on experience and demonstrated expertise.



At QCS we're committed to building long-term careers—not simply filling positions.



We offer:

• Competitive remuneration

• Performance bonus opportunities

• Structured onboarding and ongoing training

• Daily collaboration with experienced Australian brokers and our Lending Manager

• A supportive and experienced offshore team

• Exposure to residential, commercial, business and private lending

• Genuine career progression opportunities

Benefits After Successful Completion of Six Months

• SSS subsidy

• PhilHealth subsidy

• HDMF subsidy

• Paid Annual Leave

• Paid Personal Leave

• Christmas Bonus

• Annual Performance Review

• Salary Review

• Professional development opportunities

________________________________________

Our Culture



Our team is built on five core values:



Integrity

Doing the right thing, every time.

Ownership

Taking responsibility and following through.

Continuous Improvement

Always looking for better ways to serve our clients.

Professionalism

Delivering work we're proud of.

Teamwork

Supporting each other to achieve outstanding results.



We're looking for someone who shares these values and wants to build a long-term future with Queensland Capital Solutions.

________________________________________

title: 5 Star Editor Needed for 75 Hard!
description:
$400/month | Part-Time | 75-Day Contract with Permanent Consideration | Applications close in 48 hours

What this job actually is:

I’m about to start a 75 Hard challenge on August 10th, and I’m documenting the entire journey on social media. This role is you editing that footage into daily content for Instagram and a weekly talking-head video for YouTube — following me through the workouts, the routine, the wins, the hard days, all of it, for 75 straight days.

I record everything myself on my phone and upload raw footage to a Google Drive folder, organized by date. Your job is to turn that raw footage into finished, polished content on a consistent daily schedule. This isn’t a one-off gig — it’s a real commitment for 75 days, and if your work is strong and reliable through that stretch, there’s genuine potential for this to turn into a long-term, ongoing role beyond the challenge.

This is an editing-driven role, not a footage-driven one. The raw footage is just raw material. What makes this content work is the edit itself. I don’t want a video that just plays out in order and feels like watching someone’s day pass by in real time. I want the editing to carry the content — the pacing, the cuts, the transitions, the texture. If the edit isn’t doing the work, the video isn’t doing its job.

What I need from you:

 • 2 Instagram videos per day, fast-paced, quick cuts, punchy transitions, big bold modern text overlays (nothing dated), sound effects on the cuts

 • Match cut / clone transitions — the kind where an object or motion hides the cut so it looks seamless or magical. Example: I toss my shoes and they’re suddenly on my feet, or I pull my shirt and it transforms into a new outfit.

 • 1 YouTube talking-head video per week

 • Fast turnaround — if you can turn a punchy 30-second video around in 2 to 4 hours, tell me that directly

 • Reliability to hit revisions within 24 hours if I ask for changes or a re-upload

Read this fully before applying. If you don’t follow the instructions below, your application will not be considered.

To apply, you must include a link to an existing edited video (yours or a past client’s) that has all of the following: quick cuts, bold modern text overlays, and match cut / clone transitions. It doesn’t need to be “day in the life” content specifically — any video showing this exact editing style works. This is the style I need every day, on a fast turnaround, so it needs to already be something you do regularly, not something you’re willing to try.

If you don’t have a video showing this style, don’t apply. That means you haven’t done this work before, and this role requires someone who already has.

Process:

 • Applications close in 48 hours

 • Selected applicants will be sent a paid test video this weekend ($15, half upfront half on delivery)

 • Final hire decision by Monday

If your application doesn’t include a video matching this exact style, it won’t be reviewed. I’m hiring fast and I need someone who can hit the ground running immediately.
