title: Content Writer & Content Strategist (SaaS & B2B)
description:
Help turn ideas into industry-leading content. 



At Hutility, we're building software that helps businesses work smarter—from ERP integrations to workforce management and AI-powered tools. We're looking for a curious, research-driven Content Strategist & Writer who enjoys learning complex topics and turning them into content that educates, builds trust, and drives organic growth. 



This isn't a traditional content writing role where you'll be handed topics and asked to write blog posts. 



Instead, you'll work closely with our leadership team and subject matter experts to uncover valuable ideas hidden inside customer conversations, meeting transcripts, product discussions, support tickets, and industry trends. You'll use AI as a research and productivity tool—not as a replacement for critical thinking—to create content people actually want to read. 



If you're naturally curious, enjoy interviewing people, and love connecting ideas, you'll fit right in. 



 



What You'll Do 



- Research our products, customers, competitors, and industry to identify valuable content opportunities.  

- Interview subject matter experts, product leaders, and internal teams to capture insights that aren't available through traditional keyword research.  

- Turn internal knowledge—including meeting transcripts, customer questions, support tickets, documentation, and product updates—into high-value content.  

- Develop content strategies that support SEO, AI search (AEO), thought leadership, and customer education.  

- Write and edit blogs, website content, LinkedIn posts, newsletters, case studies, product guides, landing pages, knowledge base articles, and video scripts.  

- Collaborate with SEO and leadership to prioritize topics based on customer needs, search behavior, and business goals.  

- Use AI tools to accelerate research, organize information, generate outlines, and improve productivity while ensuring every piece reflects human expertise and editorial judgment.  

- Repurpose long-form content into multiple formats across different channels.  

- Continuously improve content using performance insights, search trends, and audience feedback.  



 What We're Looking For 

We're less interested in someone who simply enjoys writing and more interested in someone who loves learning. 



You may be a great fit if you: 

- Are naturally curious and enjoy researching unfamiliar topics.  

- Can simplify technical or complex concepts into clear, engaging content.  

- Enjoy interviewing experts and asking thoughtful questions.  

- Think like a teacher, journalist, or investigator rather than just a copywriter.

title: Accountant / Financial Analyst for UK M&A Firm (Full Training Provided)
description:
Work directly with the founders of an international M&A advisory firm. Learn deal analysis from the inside.



Hi! We are 5D Capital Partners, an M&A advisory firm working across the UK, US and UAE. We help business owners buy and sell companies, typically businesses making $500k to $5m in profit per year.



We are looking for a full-time Accountant / Financial Analyst to join our team and take ownership of our deal analysis.



THE ROLE

Every business we look at gets analysed on our deal sheet. It is a fixed template. Your job is to take the company accounts and seller information, fill in the template, tie all the numbers up so everything reconciles, and give a clear view on whether the deal makes sense.



You will also be the numbers person for two small companies we run: managing the accounts and cash flow, giving us your honest input on what the numbers are telling us, and finding and implementing ways to cut costs. 



We do not want someone who just records the figures. We want opinions.



Honest scope check: I complete the deal sheets myself right now and I am not even an accountant. So this is not complicated work. It is careful work. If you have an accounting background, you can do this well, and we will train you fully on the M&A side.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Complete deal sheets from our template using company accounts, broker listings and seller documents

Manage the accounts and cash flow for two small companies in our group

Review our spending, find cost savings, and implement them, not just suggest them



Give the founders your honest view on the numbers: what is working, what is not, what needs attention



Tie every number back to its source and flag anything that does not add up

Adjust profit figures for one-off costs and owner expenses to find the true earnings (add-backs)



Check if asking prices are reasonable against the earnings



Spot the red flags: falling sales, too much debt, one big customer, owner doing everything



Write a short, clear summary in plain English with your verdict

Later on, as you grow: financial modelling, forecasts and valuation work



YOU MUST HAVE

- An accounting or finance background: CPA, accounting degree, bookkeeping, or solid experience preparing management accounts

- Confidence reading financial statements: profit and loss, balance sheet, cash flow

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

- Excellent attention to detail. One wrong number means a wrong decision on a real deal

- Very good written English. Your summaries go straight to the founders

- Confidence to speak up. If you see a problem or a saving, we want to hear it

- Reliability. You hit deadlines and keep your own tracker without being chased



YOU DO NOT NEED

- Any M&A, investment banking or corporate finance experience. The template does the heavy lifting and we provide full training. We care about your accounting foundation, your accuracy and your willingness to learn.



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with UK or US company accounts

- Any exposure to financial modelling or business valuation

- Comfortable using AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude to work faster



WHY THIS ROLE IS A GREAT ONE

- You will analyse more real businesses and real deals in six months than most accountants see in years

- Full training on M&A deal analysis, a rare and valuable skill

- Real responsibility and a real voice. Your input directly shapes decisions

- Clear growth path into financial modelling and valuation

- Work directly with the founders

- Long-term, stable, full-time role



THE DETAILS

- Full time, working UK business hours

- Salary: $1,000 to $1,500 per month depending on experience, with bonuses on top for great performance

- Permanent work-from-home



HOW TO APPLY

We read every application, so please follow these steps exactly:

1. Start your application with the word LEDGER so we know you read the whole post.

2. Attach your CV.

3. Record a short Loom video, 2 minutes maximum: introduce yourself, tell us about your accounting background, and describe the most complex set of accounts you have worked with.

4. In one short paragraph, answer this: what are the first three things you would check to d
 if a business is worth buying?



Applications without the code word or the video will not be considered.



Many thanks,

Mike

title: Community Engagement Specialist (Social Media)
description:
SOCIAL MEDIA - Community Engagement Specialist — Whiskey, Wine & Spirits Communities (Reddit +
)



Job Description



We're **What's in the Bottle**, a cinematic documentary series that goes behind the label of the world's most interesting spirits, wines, and beverages. We've filmed inside real distilleries — Michter's, Teeling, and more — and our episodes are genuinely good. Our problem is simple: **not enough people have found them yet.**



That's your job.



We're looking for someone to become a real, trusted member of online communities where drink lovers hang out — bourbon and whiskey subreddits, wine and cocktail
 groups, Instagram and Threads — and to grow our audience the *human* way: by being a genuine, helpful, enthusiastic participant, not a spammer.



**This is NOT a "post links and run" job.** Anyone who blasts links gets banned in a week, and that's the opposite of what we want. This role is about patience, personality, and relationship-building. You'll spend most of your time just being a good community member — liking, commenting, answering questions, sharing your love of spirits and craft. Then, once you're trusted and it's genuinely relevant, you'll invite people to watch an episode and share feedback.



If you actually enjoy whiskey/wine culture (or are excited to learn it), you'll be great at this.



### What you'll do day to day

- Join and stay active in assigned communities (subreddits,
 groups, Instagram/Threads)

- Comment thoughtfully, answer questions, react to and support other members' posts

- Build a genuine reputation and following in each community over time

- Share our trailers and episodes **only when it adds value and follows each community's rules**

- Invite viewers to watch and give honest feedback on our episodes

- Track daily activity in a simple shared sheet (communities, actions, links shared, responses)

- Flag interesting conversations, potential fans, and brand mentions to us

- Follow the engagement playbook we provide (do's, don'ts, and anti-spam rules)



### What we're looking for

- **Excellent written English** — natural, friendly, native-sounding comments (this is the #1 skill)

- Real interest in (or curiosity about) whiskey, wine, spirits, or cocktails

- Experience with 
 and
 Groups — you understand community etiquette and how NOT to look like a marketer

- Self-motivated and consistent — this job rewards showing up every day

- Honest and patient — you get that trust is built slowly

- Bonus: experience with community management, social media, or forum moderation

- Bonus: you already drink/collect/enjoy spirits or wine



### Tools you'll use

- Reddit,
, Instagram, Threads (and possibly LinkedIn)

- Google Sheets (activity tracking)

- Basic messaging with our team 
 / chat)



### Hours & schedule

**3 hours a day, 5 days a week (~15 hours/week).** Consistency matters more than a fixed clock — communities reward daily presence, not one big burst. Short daily activity beats long occasional sessions. Hours can increase over time as results grow.



---



## How to Apply (please read — we ignore generic applications)



To show us you actually read this, start your application with the word **"CRAFT"** at the top.



Then tell us:

1. Which drink communities or hobbies are you personally into? (whiskey, wine, cocktails, beer, anything — or be honest if it's new to you)

2. Are you active on Reddit and/or
 groups? Share a profile or example if you're comfortable.

3. Write us a short, natural comment (2–3 sentences) you'd leave on a post where someone asks *"What's a good bourbon under $50?"* — show us your voice.

4. Your availability (hours/week) and monthly rate expectation.



We'll invite strong applicants to a short **paid trial task** before hiring.



Social Media Management · Community Management · Content Moderation · English Writing · Reddit ·
 Marketing · Customer Engagement · Copywriting

title: Ecommerce Escalations & Chargeback Disputes Specialist
description:
Ecommerce Escalations & Chargeback Disputes Specialist (Shopify, Fashion)



We are a growing fashion ecommerce brand selling apparel to customers in the United States and Canada. We are scaling up fast, and we need someone to own the two areas that hurt us most right now: escalated customer cases and chargebacks.



This is NOT a general ticket-answering role. We already have a support team handling standard tickets. We are looking for a specialist who can take full ownership of disputes and who is able to figure out WHY problems happen instead of only responding to them. 



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Own our entire chargeback process end to end: monitor incoming disputes, gather evidence, build and submit representments before the deadline, and track win rates.

- Handle all escalated customer cases: angry customers, complaints, refund and goodwill decisions. You will have the authority to make these decisions yourself within agreed limits.

- Own the returns and refunds experience. Make sure refunds are processed fast, returns are easy to initiate, and customers always know where their return stands. Slow refunds are one of the biggest dispute drivers in apparel.

- Analyse root causes. Tag and categorise tickets, find out what drives our support spikes and our chargebacks, and report on it monthly.

- Track sizing and fit complaints and report them back to us so we can fix product pages and size guides.

- Reduce disputes at the source: proactive delay notifications, clearer delivery expectations, faster refunds, clearer billing descriptors.

- Build the playbooks, macros and SLAs our support team will work from.



WHAT WE REQUIRE



- Hands-on experience fighting chargebacks for an ecommerce store. This is the single most important requirement.

- Experience with Shopify, and with a fashion or apparel brand. You understand sizing complaints, returns, exchanges and wardrobing.

- Experience with a helpdesk tool Re;amaze

- Excellent written English. You will be writing directly to North American customers.

- Strong discipline around deadlines. A missed dispute window is an automatic loss.

- Able to work independently and report proactively. We do not want to chase you for updates.



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience with chargeback automation tools such as Chargeflow or Disputifier.

- Experience with Whop and Shopify Payments.

- Experience at a store that scaled quickly or dealt with unpredictable volume spikes.



WORKING HOURS



At the start the working hours will be part time and eventually when there is more work you can grow out to be fulltime employee. We need someone that is flexibel also in the weekends.



HOW TO APPLY



Please do not send a generic application. Applications missing the items below will be ignored.



1. Describe one chargeback case you personally fought. What was the reason code, what evidence did you submit, and did you win?

2. We receive 20 to 50 chargebacks per month on an apparel store selling to the US and Canada. In your first 30 days, what would you look at first to bring that number down?

3. List the helpdesk and chargeback tools you have used, and for how long.

4. Start your reply with the word DISPUTE so we know you read this.



We reply to every application that follows these steps.

title: E-Commerce Content Creator & AI Product Visual Specialist
description:
Schedule: Flexible

About the Position



We are looking for a highly creative, detail-oriented remote content creator to improve product photography and video content across four e-commerce and nonprofit brands.



This is not a basic social-media posting position. Your primary responsibility will be turning existing product photographs, website content, and raw media into polished, realistic, conversion-focused images and short-form videos.



You will use tools such as Grok Imagine, Photoroom, Canva, Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, and CapCut to create lifestyle images, marketplace infographics, product demonstrations, unboxing-style videos, social-media content, and cohesive website imagery.



The right person must understand the difference between creating a beautiful image and creating an image that accurately represents the real product. AI-generated content must not change important product details.



## The Four Brands



### The Room Collective



An online pet-supplies store offering grooming tools, cleanup products, walking accessories, and practical pet-friendly home products.



You will:



* Improve current website product images

* Create realistic lifestyle images showing products being used with dogs

* Create feature, benefit, size, material, and instruction infographics

* Build complete Walmart-ready product image series

* Create vertical product demonstrations and UGC-style videos

* Create unboxing-style and problem-and-solution videos

* Prepare images for Shopify, Walmart, TikTok, Instagram, and

* Maintain the exact appearance of the real product



### Crystal City Designs



A live-orchid and gift-arrangement brand selling orchid arrangements with crystals through Amazon, Etsy, and other channels.



You will:



* Enhance real orchid photographs

* Improve lighting, backgrounds, cropping, and composition

* Create realistic home, office, gifting, entryway, and tabletop lifestyle scenes

* Create Amazon and Etsy product-image series

* Design size, planter, crystal, orchid-care, packaging, and gifting infographics

* Create realistic image-to-video content from existing orchid photographs

* Maintain the correct flower color, number of stems, planter, crystal type, arrangement, and proportions



### O.M. Thrift



An online resale business offering clothing, shoes, accessories, and other pre-owned merchandise.



You will:



* Audit and reorganize existing listing photographs

* Select the strongest image as the cover photo

* Improve lighting, exposure, cropping, backgrounds, and color consistency

* Remove distracting background elements when appropriate

* Create occasional styling collages and outfit inspiration

* Keep garments looking authentic rather than overly artificial

* Preserve all condition details and disclosed flaws

* Organize completed images by SKU or listing

* Prepare consistent images for Shopify and resale marketplaces



### Giving Blooms Foundation



A Miami-Dade nonprofit focused on collecting, redistributing, reusing, and responsibly diverting clothing and essential goods.



You will:



* Improve real photographs of donations, sorting, operations, distributions, and events

* Create branded impact graphics and educational content

* Turn real photographs and clips into short mission-focused videos

* Create social-media assets using approved organizational facts

* Follow the organization’s brand guide and AI context packet

* Never fabricate beneficiaries, volunteers, partnerships, events, testimonials, or impact results

* Never present an AI-generated scene as documentation of a real charitable activity



## Primary Responsibilities



* Audit the images currently used across all four websites

* Create a prioritized production list based on active and important products

* Improve weak, inconsistent, or poorly organized product images

* Create realistic AI-assisted lifestyle images from real reference photographs

* Create marketplace-compliant infographics

* Create product demonstrations from still images and raw clips

* Produce UGC-style, unboxing-style, problem-and-solution, and product-feature videos

* Edit videos with appropriate pacing, music, captions, text, transitions, and calls to action

* Resize and export content correctly for each marketplace and social network

* Upload approved images to the correct products and websites

* Create social-media content using current website products and information

* Organize source files and completed assets by brand and product

* Maintain a production tracker showing what is pending, completed, approved, and published

* Review every AI-generated asset against the real product before submitting it



## Required Skills



You must have strong working experience with:



* Grok Imagine

* AI image-to-video generation

* Photoroom

* Canva

* CapCut or comparable video-editing software

* Product-photo enhancement

* Realistic AI lifestyle-image creation

* E-commerce infographics

* Vertical videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and
 Reels

* Shopify product imagery

* File organization and naming

* Written English and proofreading

* Following detailed brand instructions



Experience with the following is strongly preferred:



* Adobe Firefly

* Midjourney

* Amazon product-image requirements

* Walmart Marketplace image requirements

* Etsy listing images

* Metricool

* Clothing resale photography

* Pet-product content

* Live-plant or floral photography



## Content Standards



Every finished asset must be:



* Realistic and commercially usable

* Based on the correct source product

* Free from spelling and grammar errors

* Properly sized for its intended platform

* Consistent with the correct brand

* Organized under the correct product or SKU

* Checked for AI distortions and invented details

* Designed to help customers understand and purchase the product



AI must not materially change:



* Product shape or construction

* Product color or pattern

* Included parts or accessories

* Logos, packaging, or labels

* Orchid color, stems, planter, crystals, or proportions

* Clothing fabric, buttons, print, condition, or flaws



You must be willing to reject and regenerate inaccurate AI content. A realistic-looking image is not acceptable if it misrepresents the item being sold.



## Video Standards



Videos should generally be created in vertical 9:16 format and should include:



* A strong opening hook

* Clear product visibility

* Natural movement

* A recognizable problem, benefit, demonstration, or use case

* Readable on-screen text

* Appropriate captions

* Clean editing and pacing

* A clear call to action

* Music or audio suitable for commercial use



AI-generated UGC-style videos must not include fabricated customer reviews or pretend that an AI-generated person is a verified customer.



## Initial Priorities



Work will begin in this order:



1. The Room Collective’s products intended for Walmart and TikTok

2. Crystal City Designs’ active Amazon and Etsy orchid listings

3. O.M. Thrift’s highest-value and most marketable inventory

4. Giving Blooms Foundation’s ongoing social and impact content



This is a large, ongoing project. We do not expect all four websites to be completed immediately. Work will be organized into weekly production batches.



## Expected Weekly Output



After onboarding, the normal target will be approximately:



* 4–6 complete product-image series

* 4–6 edited vertical product videos

* Website image corrections and organization

* Supporting social-media graphics as assigned

* An updated production tracker



Quality and product accuracy are more important than rushing through a large quantity of unusable AI content.



## Paid Skills Test



Finalists will complete a small paid test using source images provided by us.



The test will include:



1. Creating a Walmart-style image series for one pet product

2. Creating a realistic lifestyle image and infographic for one orchid arrangement

3. Enhancing and correctly sequencing several clothing photographs

4. Creating one short vertical image-to-video product advertisement



You will be evaluated on:



* Product accuracy

* Realism

* Visual quality

* Marketplace suitability

* Creativity

* Spelling

* Ability to follow instructions

* File organization

* Communication

* Turnaround time



## How to Apply



Begin your application with the words:



**GROK CONTENT SPECIALIST**



Then provide:



1. A short explanation of your experience creating e-commerce product images and videos

2. Links to your strongest product-image examples

3. Links to at least three short-form product videos you personally created

4. An example of a real source photograph and the finished image you created from it

5. A list of the AI and editing tools you use confidently

6. Your experience with Grok Imagine and image-to-video creation

7. Your experience with Shopify, Amazon, Walmart, Etsy, or resale marketplaces

8. Your requested hourly rate

9. Your weekly availability

10. Confirmation that you are willing to complete a paid skills test



Do not send a generic application or only share unrelated logos, flyers, wedding graphics, or social-media quotes. We need to see realistic product images, marketplace infographics, and short-form product videos.

title: Expert Media Buyer (Facebook Ads & Google)
description:
Scaling Edge is an AI-first business development agency based in London, working with coaches, consultants, finance brands, property firms, and professional service businesses. We build paid acquisition systems, AI lead generation infrastructure, and automation workflows that drive measurable revenue for our clients. We've generated over £3M in client sales through our paid and organic systems, and we're scaling fast.



We're looking for a senior media buyer who can take ownership of client ad accounts, launch and optimise campaigns end-to-end, and operate as a client-facing strategist.



The Role



This is a hands-on, client-facing position. You'll own the day-to-day execution of paid media for a portfolio of clients: building campaigns inside Meta Ads Manager, uploading creatives, customising prebuilt funnels and workflows in GoHighLevel, writing copy, briefing creative, optimising performance, and reporting directly to clients.



You will NOT be building funnels or automations from scratch. Our workflows, funnel templates, and automations are already built; your job is to plug clients in, tweak, customise, and optimise.



We use AI heavily across our workflows (Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney, image and video generation tools), so you need to be fluent in leveraging AI to move faster without sacrificing output quality.



What You'll Be Doing



Media Buying & Account Management



Build campaigns from scratch inside Meta Ads Manager (campaign structure, ad sets, audiences, placements)

Upload ad creatives, write and test copy variations, manage budgets

Run structured 3 to 5 day testing protocols and scale winners

Daily account monitoring, audience research, and optimisation decisions

Focus on CPL, CAC, and ROAS across multiple client verticals (finance, property, coaching, professional services)

Funnel & Workflow Customisation (Prebuilt in GoHighLevel)



Customise and tweak our prebuilt call funnels, webinar funnels, landing pages, and
/SMS/WhatsApp sequences inside GHL

Adjust copy, branding, and offers per client

Make sure pixels, tracking, and CRM integrations are firing correctly

Ad Copy & Creative Direction



Write direct-response ad copy across hooks, body, and CTAs

Use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to accelerate copywriting, ideation, and angle testing

Write video ad scripts (UGC, talking head, VSL, story-led)

Brief image ad designers with clear visual direction and assess output against best practice

Review and critique video ads against retention, hook strength, pacing, and conversion criteria

Client Communication & Reporting



Run client calls (kickoffs, weekly check-ins, performance reviews)

Send out clear, well-written weekly performance reports

Stay active and responsive on WhatsApp and Slack throughout the working day

Translate ad data into clear business language for non-technical founders

Manage expectations, set realistic KPIs, and own the relationship

What You Need to Have



3+ years managing Meta Ads accounts with meaningful budgets

GoHighLevel experience is mandatory, not negotiable

Perfect written and spoken English, you'll be client-facing daily

Strong copywriting chops, you can write a hook, a VSL, and a follow-up sequence without hand-holding

Comfortable using AI tools daily for copy, ideation, and creative briefs

Strong creative eye, you can look at an image ad or video ad and know what's wrong with it

Experience scripting video ads (UGC, talking head, story-driven)

Confident on client calls, you can present numbers, push back when needed, and hold the room

Active and responsive communicator on Slack and WhatsApp during working hours

Self-managed, organised, and proactive (we don't micromanage)

Nice to Have



Experience in finance, property, or high-ticket coaching verticals

LinkedIn Ads or Google Ads experience

ClickUp or Notion-based agency workflow experience

How to Apply



When applying, please include:



A short note on the highest-performing campaign you've personally run (numbers, vertical, what made it work)

Confirmation of your GoHighLevel experience and the types of funnels you've worked inside

Your availability, timezone, and preferred working hours

We move fast and make decisions quickly. If you're a strong fit, expect to hear back within 48 hours.

title: Shopify Website Optimization Specialist (Luxury Fashion Brand) Project Overview
description:
Shopify Website Optimization Specialist (Luxury Fashion Brand)

Project Overview



FMB Apparel is a premium streetwear and athleisure brand built around loyalty, family, and elevated everyday essentials.



Important: I am not looking to rebuild my website from scratch or change my brand identity. My website is already established, and I am happy with its overall direction.



I am looking for an experienced Shopify expert who can refine, improve, and elevate my existing website into a more polished, luxury shopping experience.



The goal is to make the site feel as premium, clean, and effortless as the world's leading minimalist fashion brands while maintaining FMB Apparel's unique identity and story.



This project is focused on improvements, optimization, and attention to detail, not creating a completely new website.



About My Brand



FMB Apparel is the primary brand and represents premium streetwear and everyday luxury.



Within FMB Apparel is Day1 Collective, our sister brand dedicated to premium performance apparel. Day1 Collective is a "store within a store"—it shares the same Shopify website but serves a different purpose and customer.



FMB Apparel = Premium streetwear and elevated everyday essentials.

Day1 Collective = Premium performance apparel designed for training, running, the gym, and an active lifestyle.



One of the goals of this project is to improve how these two brands coexist within one website. Customers should clearly understand the difference between the two brands while enjoying a seamless shopping experience. The navigation should make it easy to move between FMB Apparel and Day1 Collective without confusion.



Scope of Work



I am looking for someone who can evaluate my existing Shopify store and recommend improvements that will enhance:



Overall visual presentation

User experience (UX)

Navigation

Mobile responsiveness

Product pages

Homepage layout

Collection organization

Customer shopping journey

Conversion rate optimization

Website speed

Brand consistency

The integration and presentation of both FMB Apparel and Day1 Collective



I want every page to feel intentional, clean, modern, and premium.



Specific Improvements

Homepage

Refine the current homepage instead of replacing it.

Improve visual hierarchy.

Enhance spacing and layout.

Create a stronger luxury feel.

Improve brand storytelling.

Better showcase both FMB Apparel and Day1 Collective while maintaining clear brand distinction.

Improve calls-to-action.

Make the homepage more engaging without making it cluttered.

Navigation

Simplify menus where appropriate.

Improve customer flow.

Make products easier to find.

Create a clear shopping experience for both brands.

Ensure customers immediately understand the difference between FMB Apparel and Day1 Collective.

Product Pages

Improve page layout.

Enhance image presentation.

Improve product descriptions and formatting.

Create a more premium shopping experience.

Add helpful trust-building elements where appropriate.

Overall Design

Improve typography.

Improve spacing and alignment.

Create better visual consistency.

Refine colors and button styles.

Maintain a clean, minimalist aesthetic.

Ensure every page feels cohesive.

Mobile Experience

Review every page on mobile.

Improve responsiveness.

Make shopping easy on all screen sizes.

Improve loading speed where possible.

Design Direction



The website should communicate:



Luxury

Minimalism

Premium quality

Editorial fashion

Modern simplicity

Confidence

Clean architecture

High-end shopping experience



The objective is to create a timeless luxury shopping experience inspired by the best in premium fashion while remaining uniquely FMB Apparel and Day1 Collective.



What I Am NOT Looking For

A complete website rebuild.

A new brand identity.

A new logo.

A new color palette.

A different overall aesthetic.

A generic Shopify template.



Instead, I want someone who can recognize what is already working and elevate it through thoughtful refinements and professional design improvements.



Deliverables

A comprehensive audit of my current website.

A prioritized list of recommended improvements.

Implementation of approved enhancements.

Improved homepage and collection pages.

Better navigation and shopping flow.

Enhanced product pages.

Clear integration of both FMB Apparel and Day1 Collective.

Mobile optimization.

Performance improvements.

Final testing and quality assurance.

Required Skills

Expert Shopify experience

Shopify 2.0

Liquid

HTML/CSS

JavaScript

UX/UI Design

Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

Luxury Fashion E-commerce

Responsive Web Design

Performance Optimization

Please Include With Your Proposal



Before submitting a proposal, please review my current website at 
. I am looking for thoughtful recommendations—not a generic proposal.



Please include:



A brief audit of my current website.

Three to five specific improvements you would make.

Examples of Shopify stores you have improved (not just built).

Before-and-after examples of optimization work.

Estimated timeline.

Estimated project cost.

Why you are the right fit for this project.

Success Looks Like



When customers visit FMB Apparel, they should immediately recognize they are shopping with a premium fashion brand. The website should feel sophisticated, easy to navigate, visually consistent, and effortless to shop.



Customers should also immediately understand that Day1 Collective is FMB Apparel's premium performance division—a store within a store—without feeling like they have left the website.



The objective is to elevate and perfect my existing website—not replace it.

title: Content Producer for Podcast Agency
description:
Content Producer (Freelance, Remote)



We run a podcast production agency for businesses and creators, and we need more Content Producers on our roster on projects as they come, paid per project.



Here's the job: you get a raw 30-90 minute recording. Usually unfiltered. Often a ramble. You turn it into a package the editor & graphic designer can actually execute - cut list, show notes, thumbnail direction, plus the cutdowns that bring people back to the main feed.



You would be a great fit if you can write a strong brief. We move fast and our clients want their content turned around quickly, so dependable communication and clean delivery matter as much as the edit itself.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Find the real story in a long conversation and write a cut list the editor can follow

- Direct the thumbnail (you're not designing it) and write the SEO title and show notes

- Spec the cold open, a 90-second short, and a 12-minute mid-form cut

- When there's no brand kit, pull the brand direction out of past episodes yourself



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Tight writer with editorial taste

- Can make a call when the brief is messy and the client is a real human with opinions

- Work with minimal hand holding

- English fluency



Remote, project-based, small teams. We've spent a lot of time building the operational layer around this role - templates, brief format, feedback loop - so you're not stuck doing PM work. You should be spending your time on the editorial calls.



This starts per project with steady volume for the right person, and it can grow into more consistent work over time. The first step after we review portfolios is a short paid test edit.



If you're good at this, apply.



HOW TO APPLY

Short form, takes about 2 minutes:





Put the word "atlas" somewhere in your answers so we know you read this far.



You'll go into our roster. When a project lines up with you, the hiring manager reaches out.

AMS Management LLC is a boutique e-commerce advertising agency managing paid media, catalogue, and growth services for brands selling on Amazon, Walmart, and Chewy. We are a fully remote, distributed team working across time zones, 



Role Purpose

The PPC Assistant supports the Account Manager and PPC Manager/Lead in the day-to-day PPC execution, monitoring, and reporting of client advertising accounts across Amazon, Walmart, and Chewy. This is an experienced execution role, mid-level position. Monitoring and pacing

Monitor account health, disapproved ads, and out-of-budget campaigns and escalate promptly

Track performance against ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CTR, and CVR targets and highlight anomalies

Flag ASINs with declining conversion or traffic trends

Flag pricing changes affecting conversion and suppressed listings causing ads not to deliver



Reporting and administration

Prepare weekly performance snapshots and monthly reporting inputs for the Account Manager to review

Keep client dashboards, trackers, and data pulls accurate and up to date

Document work in the WOS with clear status updates and turnaround estimates

Track time to complete tasks with the WOS

Maintain organised account documentation and change logs in the WOS

Investigate major week-on-week performance changes

Highlight opportunities, risks and recommended actions



Team collaboration

Work closely with the Account Manager, project manager, catalogue team, and graphic designer to align advertising with listing content and imagery

Follow agency SOPs and contribute improvements where processes can be tightened

Communicate proactively and asynchronously across time zones



Requirements

3 to 5 years of hands-on PPC experience, with meaningful time spent inside Amazon Ads consoles

Solid working knowledge of Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaign types

Fluent understanding of core marketplace metrics including ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CTR, CVR, and impression share, and what movements in each actually mean

Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills for bulk file work, data pulls, and reporting

High attention to detail and accuracy when making changes in live client accounts

Fluent written English and reliable, responsive async communication

Reliable remote setup and availability with meaningful overlap with US working hours

Comfortable taking direction, following SOPs, and asking questions early rather than guessing

Ability to prioritise multiple deadlines 



Nice to have

Experience with Walmart Connect or Chewy Ads, or proven ability to master new ad platforms quickly

Experience with Scale Insights or similar PPC automation and analytics tools

Agency experience managing multiple client accounts in parallel

Exposure to DSP campaigns

Experience with bulk operations files and large-scale campaign restructures

Familiarity with ClickUp



Success Measures

Pacing: daily budget checks completed on schedule with issues flagged same day

Reporting: weekly snapshots delivered on time and requiring minimal rework

Independence: routine optimisation tasks executed to brief without repeated correction.

Ability to manage multiple client accounts independently after onboarding

Paid Time off

Job Title: Media Buyer (Meta Ads Specialist) – Full-time



**About us:**



We're a growing e-commerce brand selling products across 3 European markets. We are scaling fast and need a results-driven Media Buyer who knows how to turn ad spend into profit. No agencies, we are looking for a dedicated individual to join our team.



**The work:**



You will be responsible for the entire Meta ads ecosystem. We provide the raw content and briefs, you help us figure out what to cut into high-converting ads and manage the execution.



- Build and launch
/Instagram ad campaigns from scratch.

- Create and test multiple audiences, creatives, and ad copy variations.

- Monitor daily performance and optimize for CPA/ROAS (not just impressions or clicks).

- Kill underperforming ads fast, scale winners faster.

- **E-commerce background:** Experience from at least 3 different markets is a big plus. You understand why hooks and pacing matter for ads that actually sell.



- **Analytical mindset:** You live in the data. You track CPA, ROAS, CTR, CPM, and conversion rates religiously.

- **Reliable communication:** You ask questions upfront and deliver on time.

- **Full-time availability:** 40 hours per week.

- **Technical setup:** You know your way around Meta Pixel and tracking.



**Example Monthly Earnings:**





- Good performance: $800

- Exceptional performance: $1,300

- Elite performance: $1,400



**To apply:**

Please send your application with the subject line: **"Media Buyer – [Your Name]"**.

mber plays an important role, and we genuinely care about the quality of the experiences we create.

title: Creator Sourcing & Influencer Outreach Specialist
description:
Creator Sourcing & Influencer Outreach Specialist



Full Time - Must map to US working hours. 



About Ingreendients



Ingreendients is a plant-based personal care brand focused on high-performing hair care and body care products made with transparent, plant-derived ingredients.



We are building a creator-led marketing program across Instagram and TikTok and are looking for a highly organized, persistent, and resourceful person to help us identify creators, manage outreach, coordinate product seeding, and build a consistent pipeline of authentic video content.



This is not a general social media posting role.



Your primary responsibility will be to help us find the right creators and turn those relationships into high-quality videos that can be tested through paid advertising.



The Role



You will spend a significant portion of each day researching creators on Instagram and TikTok who are a strong fit for our brand.



You will then organize them, evaluate their content, reach out to them, follow up, coordinate product shipments, track communication, and help move each creator from initial discovery through completed content and advertising permissions.



Our goal is to build a large and continuously growing library of authentic creator videos that can be tested across Meta, Instagram, TikTok, Amazon, and other marketing channels.



Primary Responsibilities



Creator Research and Sourcing



* Research Instagram and TikTok creators every day

* Identify creators in clean beauty, hair care, wellness, non-toxic living, fitness, motherhood, lifestyle, and related niches

* Find micro-creators, small and mid sized creators

* Review creator content for authenticity, communication style, video quality, audience alignment, and advertising potential

* Identify creators who are comfortable speaking on camera and demonstrating products

* Build and maintain a large, organized creator database

* Avoid duplicate outreach and keep creator records accurate



Creator Evaluation



For each creator, evaluate and record:



* Name

* Instagram and TikTok handles

* Platform links

* Follower count

* Estimated engagement

* Primary niche

* Audience profile

* Location

* Content style

* Video quality

* On-camera communication

* Brand fit

* Past beauty or wellness collaborations

* Contact information

* Why the creator may be a strong fit

* Potential content angle

* Outreach status



Outreach and Follow-Up



* Send personalized outreach messages by
, Instagram, and TikTok

* Avoid generic mass outreach

* Explain why each creator is relevant to the brand

* Follow up consistently and professionally

* Respond to creator questions

* Track negotiations and creator expectations

* Schedule calls when necessary

* Maintain accurate records of every interaction



Product Seeding and Content Coordination



* Collect shipping details

* Coordinate product shipments with the operations team

* Track delivery

* Follow up after product delivery

* Confirm which products and content concepts the creator will test

* Help prepare creative briefs and talking points

* Track expected delivery dates for content

* Follow up until content is received

* Organize completed videos and raw files



Whitelisting and Advertising Permissions



* Ask creators for permission to use their content in paid advertising

* Help coordinate Meta Partnership Ads, Instagram permissions, TikTok Spark Ads, and other whitelisting processes

* Maintain records of usage rights and agreed terms

* Confirm whether content can be edited, resized, and used across multiple channels

* Coordinate with the Founder and marketing team when content is ready for testing



Reporting and Organization



* Maintain a clean creator pipeline in Google Sheets, Airtable, Notion, or another approved system

* Provide daily and weekly progress updates

* Report outreach volume, replies, interested creators, products shipped, content received, and permissions secured

* Identify bottlenecks and recommend process improvements

* Create and improve SOPs for creator sourcing, outreach, follow-up, and content tracking



What Success Looks Like



The successful person in this role will consistently:



* Find high-quality, relevant creators

* Send thoughtful and personalized outreach

* Follow up without needing reminders

* Keep the creator pipeline extremely organized

* Move creators from initial contact to completed content

* Build strong and respectful creator relationships

* Help us create a growing library of authentic videos

* Improve the process over time using AI, templates, and systems



Initial Performance Expectations



During the first 30–60 days, we expect you to build a repeatable creator sourcing and outreach system.



Potential activity targets may include:



* Researching and evaluating 30–50 relevant creators per day

* Sending 15–30 personalized outreach messages per day

* Completing consistent follow-ups

* Maintaining accurate pipeline records

* Securing a growing number of interested creators each week

* Helping move creators toward product trials, completed videos, and paid advertising permissions



Quality is more important than sending large volumes of generic messages.



Required Qualifications



* Excellent written and spoken English

* Strong internet research skills

* Highly organized and detail-oriented

* Comfortable spending several hours each day researching creators

* Strong follow-up discipline

* Professional and friendly communication

* Comfortable using Instagram and TikTok

* Strong Google Sheets skills

* Comfortable learning new software and systems

* Ability to work independently and manage repetitive workflows accurately

* Willingness to work U.S. business hours

* Reliable internet and computer



referred Experience



Experience in one or more of the following is helpful:



* Influencer marketing

* Creator sourcing

* Influencer outreach

* Affiliate marketing

* Social media research

* UGC coordination

* Beauty, wellness, hair care, or consumer products

* Meta Partnership Ads

* Instagram whitelisting

* TikTok Spark Ads

* Creator databases or CRM systems



Prior experience is helpful, but intelligence, persistence, organization, communication, and willingness to learn are equally important.



## AI and Workflow Expectations



You should be comfortable using tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to:



* Research creators

* Improve outreach messages

* Personalize communication

* Summarize creator profiles

* Generate content-angle ideas

* Organize information

* Improve follow-up systems

* Create SOPs and workflow efficiencies



AI should improve the quality and speed of your work, not produce generic or impersonal outreach.



## Who You Are



You may be a strong fit if:



* You enjoy research and finding people online

* You are naturally persistent

* You do not give up after one unanswered message

* You are highly organized

* You enjoy communicating with creators

* You notice quality and authenticity in videos

* You can follow a detailed process consistently

* You take ownership without waiting for constant instructions

* You are interested in building something long-term



## To Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Your resume

2. A short introduction explaining why this role interests you

3. Any relevant influencer, outreach, research, social media, or creator-management experience





Please also complete the short application exercise below.



Application Exercise



Part 1 — Creator Research



Find 10 Instagram or TikTok creators who you believe would be a strong fit for Ingreendients.



Please include:



* Creator name

* Instagram or TikTok handle

* Platform link

* Follower count

* Content niche

* Why you selected them

* One content angle you believe they could create for the brand

* Whether you believe they would be a strong candidate for paid advertising and why



Please DO NOT select celebrities or very large creators. Focus will be on micro, small and mid-size creators.



Part 2 — Outreach



Write one personalized outreach message to one of the creators you selected.



The message should:



* Reference something specific about the creator

* Tools: Comfortable with dialers (Aircall, RingCentral, GO HighLevel), Google Workspace, Slack.

* Availability: Can work UK daytime hours consistently; minimal schedule conflicts.

* Lived/studied in an English-speaking country or attended English-medium schools.

* B2B agency, SaaS, consulting, or high-ticket service experience.

* Calendar booking + CRM automation (GoHighLevel) familiarity.

* Copy/DM outreach skills to complement calling.

* Commission: Per closed sale (uncapped).
